your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Rejecting p3's offer of Park Place and Oriental Avenue for mortgaged Ventnor Avenue. Handing p3 the Yellow monopoly when they have $387 cash and plenty of mortgageable properties to immediately build on Yellow is a losing move for me since p2 holds Vermont and Boardwalk.

Rejecting p3's offer of B&O Railroad and Short Line for Ventnor Avenue. Handing p3 the Yellow monopoly when they have $387 cash and plenty of mortgageable properties to immediately build houses right before my Green monopoly is far too dangerous compared to $200 railroad rent. Keeping p3 restricted to just the Brown monopoly leaves them as a high-cash target for my Green set.
Landed on Tennessee Avenue and paid $14 rent to p3, leaving me with $23 cash and safely past p2's developed Pinks. Keeping Green intact at 2-3-3 houses ($390/$900/$1,000 rent) and ending turn.
Selling 1 house on North Carolina Avenue for $100 to cover the $13 shortfall for the $36 rent owed to p2, preserving the 3 houses on Pennsylvania Avenue ($1,000 rent) and keeping Green at 2-2-3.
Ending turn with $87 cash buffer and Green at 2-2-3 houses while p2 sits on Water Works right before my Green monopoly.
Rolling for doubles to maximize my chances of staying in jail and avoiding p3's developed Orange monopoly right outside jail, while preserving my $1,087 cash to build up Green into hotels.

In this engine, failing a jail roll ends the turn immediately without a post-roll build phase. Since I must cross p3's Orange monopoly eventually anyway, paying $50 to leave jail now lets me cross Orange while it is still at 2-2-3 houses ($200/$200/$600) and then immediately invest my ~$1,037 cash into building up my Green monopoly during my post-roll phase before p3 leaves jail.

Building 1 house each on Pacific and North Carolina ($400 total) to bring the Green monopoly to 3-3-3 houses ($900/$900/$1,000 rent), leaving $837 cash. Will evaluate adding a 4th house on the next step.

At Community Chest (pos 17), I am past St. James and cannot roll a 1 to hit Tennessee, leaving only a 1/36 chance (snake eyes) to hit New York Avenue. Building 1 house each on North Carolina and Pennsylvania ($400 total) pushes Green to 3-4-4 houses ($900/$1,100/$1,200 rent) while keeping $437 cash buffer.
Ending turn with Green at 3-4-4 houses ($900/$1,100/$1,200 rent) and $437 cash buffer while positioned at Community Chest (pos 17), past almost all of p3's Orange monopoly.
